question: The TrailGuard AI system has implemented as an anti-poaching tool in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Similipal Tiger Reserve**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **TrailGuard AI** is an advanced anti-poaching system designed to protect wildlife from illegal poaching activities. It uses **AI-powered cameras** to detect intrusions in protected areas and send real-time alerts to authorities. 
• The **Similipal Tiger Reserve**, located in **Odisha, India**, is one of the largest tiger reserves in the country and is known for its rich biodiversity, including tigers, elephants, and other endangered species. 
• This AI system has been implemented in Similipal Tiger Reserve to combat the serious threat of **poaching**, which affects wildlife conservation efforts in the area. 
• The system consists of **hidden cameras** equipped with motion sensors and advanced AI algorithms that can distinguish between humans, animals, and other objects, ensuring precise identification of potential poachers.

• By deploying TrailGuard AI, authorities aim to enhance the efficiency of anti-poaching operations, minimize human-animal conflicts, and ensure the long-term survival of wildlife in the reserve.
